description: This Java class 'BlockNamespaceBehavior' provides functionality to block messages directed towards entities in specific namespaces. It maintains a cache of blocked namespaces and offers the 'block' method to check incoming signals and block them if their namespace is marked as blocked.

classes.name: BlockNamespaceBehavior
classes.description: A final class that encapsulates logic for blocking signals based on their namespace, utilizing a cache of blocked namespaces.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of BlockNamespaceBehavior with the provided BlockedNamespaces cache.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Checks if the given signal belongs to a blocked namespace and returns a CompletableFuture that completes with the signal or throws a NamespaceBlockedException if blocked.
